title: Community Parade Route Gets Austin Go-Ahead
summary:
*   A special meeting was held to quickly approve a parade permit for the "Town Lake Citizen's" group.
*   The community parade was scheduled for the very next day, June 11, 1978, from 9:00 A.M. to 11:00 A.M.
*   The approved route would take participants through specific East Austin neighborhoods, concluding near the I-35 bridge.
